items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: my uncle, Dui Schmid, was quite instrumental in giving me a lot of encouragement of playing piano.

ctx.x: And I just don't recall his first name right now. But I know that he played down there.

I don't know if he played on Basin Street, but I know he played at this old club on Ramport. I've heard of him. And of course, naturally, my uncle, Dui Schmid, was quite instrumental in giving me a lot of encouragement. And of course, he was a man of the union. And he was a man of the union, an old timer. And I just don't recall his first name right now. But I know that he played down there. I don't know if he played on Basin Street, but I know he played at this old club on Ramport. I've heard of him. And of…
Now, the people in those previous generations, did they play what you'd call jams?
